The IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025–26 has been officially released on 21 January 2026 on the IBPS website (ibps.in). Candidates who appeared for the RRB PO Phase‑2 (Mains) exam for Officer Scale‑I (Assistant Manager) can now log in to check whether they have qualified and view their individual marks online. To check the result, candidates need to log in using their details on the IBPS website. You can also find complete information about the scorecard and cut-off marks here for easy reference.

IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 Out @ibps.in

The IBPS RRB PO Mains exam is highly scoring and the final selection follows an 80:20 ratio between the online examination and the interview. Candidates who appeared in the mains exam held on 28th December 2025 can now check their scores and qualifying status online at the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in. This result is for Officer Scale 1, 2, and 3 posts under the IBPS RRB recruitment 2025-26. Qualified candidates will be shortlisted for the interview round, and the schedule for the next stage will be announced soon. Aspirants can download their IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26 to know their marks and plan further selection steps.

IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result Download Link

The IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 download link is now activated its official website of IBPS. Candidates who appeared in the Phase 2 exam can now directly access their IBPS RRB PO Mains Result by logging in with their registration number and password. The result link is available separately for Officer Scale 1, 2, and 3 posts under IBPS RRB recruitment 2025-26. Aspirants must download and save their IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26 for the interview stage. The direct result link for IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 is provided below for easy access.

IBPS RRB PO Mains Result Out – Direct Download Link Active

IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025: Overview

The Institute of Banking & Personnel Selection has announced a total of 3928 vacancies for IBPS RRB Officer Scale 1 (PO), along with 1184 posts for Officer Scale 2 and 202 posts for Officer Scale 3.Candidates who appeared in Phase 2 can now check the key details below.

How to Download IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26?

IBPS has activated the link to check the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 for Officer Scale 1, 2 and 3 posts. Candidates must keep their login details ready to access the result smoothly.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website — www.ibps.in
  2. Click on the “CRP RRBs” section available on the left side of the homepage.
  3. Select “Common Recruitment Process – Regional Rural Banks Phase XIV”.
  4. Now click on “Result for Online Mains Exam CRP-RRBs-XIV Officers Scale-I, II & III”.
  5. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Date of Birth/Password.
  6. Fill in the captcha code correctly and click on Submit.
  7. Your IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26 will appear on the screen.
  8. Download the result and take a printout for future use.

What After IBPS RRB Officer Scale 2 & 3 Result 2025-26?

After the IBPS RRB PO Result is declared, shortlisted candidates will be called for the Interview round. IBPS will release the interview schedule and venue details on the official website. Candidates must download their call letter and carry all required documents for verification. The final selection will be based on combined marks of the Mains exam and Interview. After that, IBPS will publish the IBPS RRB PO Final Result and allot candidates to participating Regional Rural Banks.

IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025 FAQs

Q1. Is IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 released?

Ans. Yes, the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 is now released on 21st January 2026 at the official IBPS website. Candidates who appeared in the IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26 can now check their qualifying status online.

Q2. How can I download the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result?

Ans. To download the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26, visit www.ibps.in and log in using your Registration Number and Password/Date of Birth. The IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26 link is available under CRP RRBs.

Q3. Is the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result released separately for different posts?

Ans. Yes, IBPS has released the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result separately for Officer Scale 1, Scale 2, and Scale 3 posts under IBPS RRB recruitment 2025-26.

Q4. What details are required to check the IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26?

Ans. Candidates need their Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth to access the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26 from the IBPS portal.

Q5. What happens after the IBPS RRB PO Mains Result 2025-26?

Ans. Candidates who qualify in the IBPS RRB PO Phase 2 Result 2025-26 will be called for the Interview round. Final selection will be based on Mains + Interview marks.
